title: BAW server CPU spikes to 100% every hour, causing process timeouts
description: Since the last server patch cycle, the BAW application server CPU hits 100% for about 3-4 minutes at the top of every hour. During this window new process instances cannot be created and task list operations time out. After the spike CPU returns to normal ~20% utilization.

worklogs.description: Captured thread dump during the 13:00 CPU spike. Identified a BPMDB cleanup task running a full table scan on LSW_TASK.
Found two overlapping cleanup jobs in PAC both scheduled at minute 0 of every hour. One was the default, the other added manually during the patch process.
Confirmed indexes on LSW_TASK were missing on STATUS and DUE_DATE columns.
Added composite indexes. Removed duplicate cleanup job. Rescheduled remaining job to 23:30.
Monitored for 3 hours post-change. No further spikes. Updated deployment runbook.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: This is critical. Every hour our users get timeouts for about 3 minutes. We have SLA-bound processes being delayed.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Treating this as critical priority. I am going to capture a thread dump at the next spike at 13:00 to identify what the JVM is doing. Could you confirm the BAW server hostname?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Primary node is baw-prod-01.corp.local, secondary is baw-prod-02.corp.local.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Thank you. Thread dump collected at 13:00. Analyzing now.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Thread dump shows all threads blocked on the same BPMDB cleanup query doing a full table scan on 2.3M rows in LSW_TASK. Also found a duplicate scheduled cleanup job - looks like one was added during the patch cycle. Two jobs running the same expensive query simultaneously.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Found the root cause. Two cleanup scheduled tasks are running simultaneously at the top of each hour, both doing full table scans on a large task table that is missing the required indexes. I need to remove the duplicate job and add indexes. This requires a 10-minute maintenance window. Can we do tonight 21:00-21:30?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Approved for tonight 21:00. Please coordinate with Gokhan Yilmaz from the server team.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Maintenance completed. Duplicate job removed, indexes added, remaining cleanup rescheduled to 23:30. Could you confirm the 10:00 and 11:00 slots were clean today?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Confirmed. It is 11:30 and there has been no spike. CPU is at 18-22% which is perfectly normal. Users have not reported a single timeout. Massive improvement.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Excellent. I have updated the deployment runbook so the duplicate cleanup job issue is documented for future patch cycles. Closing this ticket.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Thank you for the quick and thorough fix.

resolutionNote: Two overlapping cleanup scheduled tasks were running simultaneously at every hour on the dot, both performing full table scans on the 2.3M-row LSW_TASK table which lacked indexes on STATUS and DUE_DATE. One duplicate job was introduced during the patch cycle. Removed the duplicate, added composite indexes, rescheduled remaining job to 23:30.

csat.comment: Very thorough root cause analysis and a fast fix on a business-critical issue. The runbook update was a nice touch.
